//: Rename to instadocs.config.json and drop it next to the automation project (or in ~/.instadocs/). Any field can be omitted — omitted fields fall back to env vars, then your `uip login` session. Delete the keys you don't need.

gateway.//model: Pick a model routable in your tenant.
gateway.//servicePrefix: Optional. Auto-selected (agenthub_ for *.uipath.com, else orchestrator_). Override only for non-standard/on-prem routing.
gateway.//gatewayUrl: Optional full-URL override; wins over baseHost/organization/tenant.
gateway.//token: Optional. Prefer `uip login` (auto-refreshed). Only set a PAT/token here for headless/CI where you cannot run uip login. Do NOT commit a real token.
